Malzahar

the Prophet of the Void

Malzahar is a safe, simple mage with a passive shield that blocks poke and a point-and-click suppression ultimate. He pushes waves with almost no effort and locks down one enemy for his team. Great for new players who want a calm lane and a guaranteed pick tool.

When to pick Malzahar

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. His passive shield and easy wave clear make his lane safe, and his ultimate is useful into any team.

Pick into

  • Assassins and divers he can lock down with Nether Grasp, like Zed, Qiyana and Talon
  • Mobile champions with dashes: his suppression can't be dodged, so Yasuo and Kai'Sa get caught
  • Long-range poke mids like Zoe, whose damage gets soaked by Void Shift
  • Teams with one main carry you need to shut down

Avoid into

  • Tanky divers who don't care about his suppression, like Sion
  • Dive assassins who break his passive and kill him first, like Fizz and Diana
  • Teams that build Quicksilver effects or have lots of Cleanse

Great teammates

Jarvan IVJarvan's Cataclysm traps enemies so Malzahar's zone and W damage stack up.
ViVi and Malzahar both lock one target for a guaranteed kill.
NautilusNautilus adds even more crowd control for picks.

Your team needs: Pick Malzahar when your team has damage to follow up on his ultimate, because he suppresses but doesn't kill alone.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Nether Grasp suppresses a target and can't be dodged
  • Void Shift blocks a big chunk of damage and crowd control in lane
  • Easy wave clear with E spreading through minions and W's Voidlings
  • Simple combos and a very safe lane

Weaknesses

  • No dash: if his passive is broken, he is easy to gank
  • His ultimate can be interrupted by crowd control or cleansed with Quicksilver effects
  • Needs a couple of items to deal real damage
  • Falls behind if he can't land his ultimate on a key target

Power spikes

  • Level 2: E + Q pokes well, and your passive makes trading back hard for the enemy.
  • Level 6: Nether Grasp turns every gank into a likely kill.
  • First item (Blackfire Torch): your damage over time ramps up and your mana problems go away.
  • Two items (Liandry's Torment): E and Voidlings melt both squishies and tanks.

Top tips

  • Keep your passive up in lane by not taking random poke.
  • E jumps when its target dies: put it on a low minion to clear the wave.
  • Ping your jungler when your ultimate is up.
  • Use Q's silence to stop dashes and spells.
  • Check that your ultimate target can't be saved by an ally's crowd control.
  • Your ultimate can't be dodged, so use it on slippery champions who dodge skill shots.
